question: Does the teaching apply whether the confluence is complete or lacking?
premises: A confluence may be complete or lacking
The matter is declared to the beloved of Śambhu
inference: The teaching applies whether the confluence is complete or without parts.
uncertainties: The fragment sāṃgaṃ- likely forms a compound with saṅgamam
plain_english: O beloved of Śambhu, it is declared whether at a confluence complete or lacking.
